messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 alert — multiple CUDA_ILLEGAL_MEMORY_ACCESS events on serving-node-12. 20% error rate for model/gpt-medium-serving in us-west-2. Auto-evac attempted. Paging pressure seen.

jamie (oncall): ack. pulling logs. pinging runtime/eng.

lucy (eng-runtime): seeing repeated illegal access stack: 
```
E CudaIllegalAccess: invalid device memory access at 0x7fffa12b0000
...
GPU0: kernel misaligned address (pagewalk)
Summary: container crash -> kube restart loop -> eviction on node
```

lucy (eng-runtime): symptoms line up with recent kernel pagewalk/race (TL;DR: device addr drift causing illegal access on reload). Repro rate ~1/10 restarts locally.

eva (sre): impact? how many customers affected? can we cordon node to stop noisy restarts?

jamie (oncall): customer-facing error rate spike: 18% 5xx on that model route, about 120 requests/min failing. Sending customer notice draft to product-support.

product-support: draft received, will hold until we confirm mitigation plan.

omar (mlops): can we route traffic off model/gpt-medium-serving to gpt-small-fallback? cost hit but reduces P99 errors. Also can we disable autoscaler to avoid creating new pods on the broken node?

lucy (eng-runtime): yes do both. Also recommend cordon + drain node to avoid further restarts. We should also pin container image to last-known-good runtime v2.12 for nodes that get drained.

jamie (oncall): executing cordon/drain now.

jamie (oncall): `/kubectl cordon serving-node-12` -> ✅ cordoned. Starting `kubectl drain serving-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

incident-bot: drain job started. 12 pods scheduled to evict.

lucy (eng-runtime): logs from kubelet show kernel OOPS before crash: `bad_pte: misaligned device address walk` and then `CUDA: illegal memory access`. This looks like an SMMU/pagewalk ordering issue.

jamie (oncall): one container is failing to stop cleanly — restart loop count increasing.

lucy (eng-runtime): stop creating new pods on that node by setting nodeSelector in scheduler for that AZ until fixed. I'll push a quick placement policy to prevent scheduling to node-12.

omar (mlops): traffic shift started to gpt-small-fallback and to dedicated-dp-02 (cpu fallback) — errors dropped to 3% within 2 minutes. Good.

product-support: drafting customer notice: short blurb and ETA for rollback. Will include that we routed to fallback model and that degraded latency/cost may be seen.

eva (sre): we should collect full kernel oops and dmesg for the node before reboot. Jamie — can you capture `journalctl -k -u kubelet -b` and `dmesg -T` and upload to incident artifact storage?

jamie (oncall): grabbing logs now. Pasting last block: 
```
[ 1234.567890] BUG: kernel paging request for device address at 0000007fffa12b00
[ 1234.567892] page_walk: unaligned pointer in page table walk
[ 1234.567895] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.567899] nvidia: GPU assert: illegal memory access
```
Uploaded to: https://internal-artifacts/reports/5467899999/logs.txt

lucy (eng-runtime): thanks. I'm initiating a coordinated rollback of runtime components that touched GPU address translation in the last rollout — going back to runtime v2.12 (known stable). Will coordinate with eng-infra for node reboot sequencing.

squad-ops: will stub a canary rollout to 1 pod on a clean node once images are pushed.

omar (mlops): can we hotpatch on the node (kernel param change) to avoid the misaligned walk until we can repro and PR a fix? maybe toggle iommu settings or disable uspmmu?

eva (sre): hotpatch risky in prod while pod churn is happening. prefer drain -> reboot -> repro in staging. We'll prepare a minimal kernel config test in staging AZ.

jamie (oncall): handoff to eva for next shift. I'll finish artifacts + post customer notice. Next oncall ETA 30m.

product-support: customer notice sent to impacted customers at 22:14 PST: "We detected elevated errors on model generation. Traffic routed to fallback model; we expect reduced errors while we investigate. We're working on a fix and will update in 60 minutes."

lucy (eng-runtime): patch plan: 1) pin runtime to v2.12 and redeploy on all drained nodes. 2) repro on staging with node-level kernel logging enabled. 3) if repro consistent, collect nvcrash dump and open kernel regression with vendor. 4) long-term: add safe-guard to prevent reloads while pagewalk state present.

eva (sre): I'm taking ownership of the postmortem and timeline. jamie, please add links to artifacts and the customer notice. I'll create an incident page with severity and RCA placeholders.

jamie (oncall): added artifacts link + kube events + metrics graphs here: https://internal-ops/incident/5467899999

lucy (eng-runtime): note: for immediate mitigations we should also add an automatic fallback rule in the router: on >10% cuda_illegal in 2m, route to CPU fallback and annotate incident. Omar can you add that rule?

omar (mlops): added temporary routing rule. confirmed traffic shift. CPU usage up, cost will increase but acceptable for now.

squad-ops: once node drained and rebooted we'll run a `stress-ng` + replay load for 30m. Need eng-ml to supply a prompt set.

jamie (oncall): handing off active oncall to eva — incident status: node cordoned & drained in progress, traffic routed to fallback, runtime rollback planned, customer notice sent. Please ping if anything regresses. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. New owner: eva (sre). Incident channel will remain open for updates.

eva (sre): taking over. I'll schedule the node reboots in 10m windows, collect crash dumps, and coordinate with eng-runtime for the canary rollout.

lucy (eng-runtime): timeline estimate: rollback + canary + monitoring => 45-90m. Will update with any repro.

product-support: I'll stand by for customer follow-up if we need to extend ETA.

(End of thread)
